summary: DevOps and platform engineer with 9 years in software delivery. I currently operate the Kubernetes platform and CI/CD behind Slovakia's national e-government, and before that ran AWS infrastructure for a SaaS product with tens of thousands of customers. I started as a software developer, so I'm comfortable reading and writing code, working closely with development teams and developing whatever automation is missing.

experience.name: NASES — National e-Government Platform
bullets: Designed the architecture of the platform and am building the internal development platform on top of it, used by teams across the organisation.
Operate multi-cluster Kubernetes/OpenShift, provisioned as code with Terraform on private cloud and bare-metal.
Build and maintain the GitLab CI/CD pipelines and GitOps deployment (Argo CD, Helm): release management, day-to-day troubleshooting, and security scanning with image signing in the shared pipelines.
Responsible for secrets management (Vault), IAM (Keycloak), networking (Cilium, F5, Fortinet) and monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana).

experience.name: Medical Navigator
bullets: Developed the application itself as well as its infrastructure and CI/CD: GitHub Actions pipelines and a multi-account Terraform setup deploying to AWS ECS Fargate.

experience.name: LiveAgent
bullets: Ran the AWS infrastructure (Terraform) behind a help-desk SaaS used by tens of thousands of companies: MySQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, messaging and background workers.
Six years of development on the product itself (PHP, Java, Python, JavaScript); two years on the leadership team.

experience.name: DXC Technology
bullets: Python (Flask) and Angular on MySQL, containerised with Docker and deployed to Azure.
